decisions.statement: A credential is asked of the read handed in by the account named.
The read is asked with the log prefix this module was built with.
An account the read has no credential for is answered as no credential.
A credential is expired where its expiry is at or behind the moment read.
An expired credential is answered as no credential.
An expired credential is written about on the warning seam.
A credential expiring inside the refresh buffer is answered all the same.
A credential expiring inside the refresh buffer is written about on the warning seam.
A credential expiring beyond the refresh buffer is written about nowhere.
The refresh buffer is the span `model-account-oauth` names.
A line names the account and the moment that account's credential expires at.
The moment an expiry is weighed against is read once for one ask.
The clock is handed in so a test needs no real time.
Every line written here goes to a seam the caller may replace.
A caller hands in the read answering one account's credential.
Nothing here renews a credential.
Nothing here reads a page.
Nothing here chooses an account.
Nothing here reads a clock the caller cannot replace.
No digest of a token is answered.
No token value reaches a line written here.
A caller cannot tell a credential absent from a credential expired.
The account a credential names is weighed against the account asked for nowhere.
The expiry judgement here is spelled a second time in `oauth-effects`.
`tools/lib/model-gateway/gateway.ts` writes these two lines to the console.

definition: an account's credential while that credential has not expired
